message: `assert` is removed when Python runs with `-O`, so it should not be the only check protecting this path. Raise an explicit exception instead.
evidence: assert self._session is not None, "The session has not yet been opened."
context: 370          this context has been pushed. Accessing this property, also accessed by
>   373          assert self._session is not None, "The session has not yet been opened."
note: Carried forward from pass 1 and pass 2. The assert is introduced by this commit together with the new `session` property, so it is attributable to the change. It is the only guard on a user-reachable path, Flask raises RuntimeError elsewhere for that error class, and under -O the written message is replaced by an AttributeError on None.
